compositions.intent: Place one fixed action directly in a card footer.
rules: Place one fixed action directly in the card footer as a button.
lg-button-group is for two or more related actions, and is also acceptable when a second action may be shown conditionally.

compositions.intent: Place one fixed navigation link directly in a card footer.
rules: Place one fixed navigation action directly in the card footer as a link styled as a button.
lg-button-group is for two or more related actions, and is also acceptable when a second action may be shown conditionally.

compositions.intent: Keep the footer layout stable when a second action is sometimes shown.
rules: Use lg-button-group when a second action may be shown conditionally.
Give only one of the actions primary priority.

compositions.intent: Group two or more related actions in a card footer.
rules: For a minimum of two related actions, use lg-button-group.
Give only one of the related actions primary priority.
